'''Maiferri Tag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] recruit. She was supposed to be interviewed by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Keth Beamis]] but was arrested [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior on an espionage charge, which in turn led to Beamis' and [[Ryley Ancum]]'s arrest on suspicion of Rebel involvement.<ref name="GC6" />
